rules.quote: Specify the law report or online legal authority that hosts the relevant judgment or decision.
rules.violation_condition: A citation does not identify the law report or online legal authority hosting the judgment or decision.

rules.quote: Capitalise the names of the parties
rules.violation_condition: A party name in a case title lacks its required capitalisation.

Preserve the names as they appear in the source.

rules.violation_condition: The separator between party names in a case title is an upper-case ‘V’ rather than a lower-case ‘v’.

rules.quote: There is no full stop after ‘v’.
rules.violation_condition: The ‘v’ between party names in a case title is followed by a full stop.
when: Applies to the separator between parties in a case title.
rules.why: G-1: a full stop after the separator is distinct from incorrect capitalisation.

rules.why: G-2: the label and brackets jointly define the prescribed paragraph-reference form.

anchor.quote: For subsequent notes for the same public ruling, cite the number (and paragraphs for a pinpoint citation).

tags.violation_condition: A subsequent note for a public ruling omits its identifying number, or a subsequent pinpoint note omits the relevant paragraph reference.

when: Applies to subsequent notes for the same public ruling or determination.
Paragraph references are required when the subsequent note is a pinpoint citation.
The full title and source need not be repeated.
rules.why: G-2 and G-3: subsequent notes use one shortened citation form, with paragraphs conditional on a pinpoint.
